kypExtensions.summary: The MHC I double-cross: CD8+ T cells REQUIRE MHC I presentation while NK cells kill when MHC I is ABSENT (missing self) — viral and tumor MHC I downregulation escapes CD8+ but walks into NK. Unifies this page's kill logic with the E21 MHC note and the E20 innate/adaptive sorting.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source states the NK inhibitory signal (MHC I) and the CD8+ killing function on the same page but never states their complementary relationship; the integration and its clinical payoff (tumor/viral immune escape, therapeutic-antibody ADCC) is KYP's model.
